session.name: none
session.note: BtcTrendPullback is an H1/H4 swing grammar with NO session gate. The H4 bias uses completed H4 bars only (CompletedHtfShift mirror: containment tested with the chart bar's open time, so a bar never reads its own bucket). Do not bolt a session box onto it.

holdout.rule: et_date < 2026-04-01 develop / selection; et_date >= 2026-04-01 holdout evaluation only; NEVER used for selection

costs.slippage_note: STATED ASSUMPTION: 10% of median H1 spread 1251 pts ($1.25/side) — mirrors the BTC-NY 10%-of-median rule (160 of 1600 on M5). Not index 10 pt.
costs.max_spread_note: rounded ~p95 of FP H1 spread (p50=1251, p95=1601, p99=2150). Skip fills above cap.
costs.spread_imputation: 779 zero-spread bars: forward-fill previous bar spread within the same ET day, else global median 1251
costs.cost_formula: round trip = (spread_pts + 2 * slippage_points) * point_size * contract_size * lots + 2 * commission_per_lot * lots, charged once at fill

notes.btc_h4bias_h1_pullback_reclaim: indicator pullback setup only: H4 bias (EMA50>EMA200, strength>=1%, completed bar) + |close-EMA50|/EMA50 <= 1.5% + recovery (RSI>=50 rising, MACD-hist>=0 rising, close>prev close); mirrored short = 100-RSI
notes.btc_h4bias_h1_continuation: indicator continuation setup only: H4 strength >= 1.5% + close>=EMA50 + extension 0..3% + RSI>=54 with (RSI rising or MACD rising); mirrored short
notes.btc_h4bias_h1_full_grammar: the shipped default: pullback OR continuation (both with panic veto, ATR% floor, edge trigger); short side is the mirrored stack

fills_and_exits.signal_to_fill: signal on close of bar i, fill at open of bar i+1 (cross-ET-day fills allowed — weekend gaps are real; the indicator has no day constraint)
fills_and_exits.gap_rule: if a bar OPENS beyond SL/TP, fill at that open (BTC-NY convention)
